title: Weekly sync - serving runtime / infra / console (agenda + action items)
content:
Meeting: Weekly sync - Serving Runtime / Infra / Console
Date: 2026-03-06 (Fri) - 11:00-11:45 PT (prep notes + talking points)
Owner: Aisha Patel (notes)
Attendees (expected): Tom N., Leah O., Marcus R., Elena (console), SRE oncall if available

Purpose: quick cross-team alignment on releases, infra risks, rollout status, and carry-forward action items. Keep to 45m.

AGENDA (high level)
- 5m: Quick wins & shoutouts (all)
- 10m: Serving runtime updates (Tom)
  - model kernel selection changes merged? status of PR (#987)
  - perf regression check for long-context (>4096) workloads
- 10m: Infra & capacity (Marcus)
  - Dedicated pool scaling policy tests - any failed scenarios?
  - KV cache metrics in prod (latencies, hit rate) - are we seeing the expected uplift?
- 10m: Console / observability (Leah)
  - new per-route token cost UI - rollout plan and migration notes
  - tracing hook for prefix cache misses (obs dashboards, alerts)
- 5m: Blockers / risk review (all)
- 5m: Action-item review & next steps

PREP NOTES (things to surface in meeting)
- Serving runtime PR 987: include perf numbers - mention 7% CPU reduction on short seqs, +1% mem for KV cache change. Need approval for canary rollout. (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/987)
- ENG-1245: KV cache telemetry ticket - still in backlog for infra to wire up ingestion. If not done this week, delay rolling cache-on by default.
- Console: per-route costing UI behind feature flag; need Product to confirm copy. Ask Leah to ping PM Sam before rollout.

BLOCKERS (quick list)
- KV cache telemetry not hooked into metrics pipeline - blocks full rollout. Owner: Marcus.
- Canary jobs failing intermittently on p4d-16xlarge during autoscale tests. Need SRE log dump. Owner: Tom.
- Console feature copy outstanding; legal asked for export wording change. Owner: Leah to escalate.

ACTION ITEMS (tracked)
- [AI-1] Wire KV cache telemetry into metrics pipeline (Prometheus -> long-term storage). Owner: Marcus Rivera. Due: 2026-03-10. Jira: ENG-1245. Notes: need to add tag "kv_cache" to ingest pipeline and confirm dashboards.
- [AI-2] Investigate autoscale canary failures on p4d-16xlarge and attach logs to ticket. Owner: Tom Nguyen. Due: 2026-03-08. Linked: /incidents/logs (SRE).
- [AI-3] Send console feature flag rollout plan + copy to Product and Legal; request final signoff. Owner: Leah Ortiz. Due: 2026-03-09. Ping: Sam (PM).
- [AI-4] Run perf run for long-context (>8k) with new kernel selection defaults; capture memory & tail latency percentiles. Owner: Aisha Patel (help from infra). Due: 2026-03-12. Use harness: perf/harness-longcontext-2026.
- [AI-5] Update runbook with fallback policy examples for model variant routing (edge cases + tests). Owner: Marcus Rivera. Due: 2026-03-13. Confluence: serving-runtime-oncall-runbook.

FOLLOW-UPS FROM LAST WEEK (quick)
- KV cache canary in eu-west: half-rollout success; observed 12% token cost reduction for chat workloads. Need global telemetry to confirm. (Marcus)
- Console dashboard: added latency heatmap - Leah to expose by model id this week.
- Autoscale policy PR: reverted for hotfix, re-open after logs reviewed (Tom).

NOTES TO SELF / SCRIPTS TO RUN DURING MEETING
- Bring up the PR diff for PEX / kernel selector so PM can see the safe-guard checks (files to show: selector.py, metrics_collector.py).
- Have 2 quick slides: perf numbers (before/after), risk matrix (what can go wrong in canary).
- If SRE not present, agree on collecting logs and scheduling follow-up async deep-dive (30m) next Tue.

RISK / DECISION REQUESTS
- Decision: proceed with canary for PR#987 across 10% traffic for 48h? Recommend yes if KV telemetry hooked. (Decision owner: eng leads)
- Risk: if canary hits autoscale failure, fallback to previous kernel selector (need automation). Add test case to release pipeline.

TODO / Quick checklist (post-meeting)
- [ ] Confirm Marcus has instrumentation in staging
- [ ] Tom posts autoscale logs to ticket and tags SRE
- [ ] Leah gets PM + Legal signoff on UI copy
- [ ] Aisha schedules long-context perf run & shares results in #serving-runtime

SLACK / LINKS TO SHARE DURING SYNC
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/987
- Jira ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-1245
- Confluence runbook: confluence:serving-runtime-oncall-runbook
- Perf harness: internal:perf/harness-longcontext-2026

MEETING OUTPUT TO CAPTURE (quick)
- Finalized decision for PR#987 (yes/no + rollout fraction + preconditions)
- Confirmed owner and due dates for AI-1..AI-5
- If any blocker unresolved, schedule focused follow-up and list participants

PERSONAL NOTES (scratchpad)
- If Marcus is overloaded, escalate KV telemetry to infra-team lead (Elena) - don't let this slip (this is the critical path).
- Keep the perf run reproducible: pin model version and input shard - record seeds.
- Reminder: update weekly notes file after meeting and tag action items with Jira numbers.

END OF AGENDA - keep this doc short during meeting and convert to a follow-up email after 11:45 PT.
